name: Watch the Gates
description: Guard this settlement for as long as the spy stays: foreign spies here have a harder time (−25% chance, −10% more for each rank) and are caught more often.

name: Make Contacts
description: Learn the land within 4 tiles of the settlement and what its owner is researching.

name: Skim the Treasury
description: Steal 15% of their treasury, up to 300 gold.

name: Steal Plans
description: A boost toward one of your techs or civics. Their owner must know a tech you don't.

name: Sabotage the Works
description: Half the production put into what the settlement is building is lost.

name: Arm the Rebels
description: Two bands of raiders rise near the settlement.

name: Stir Discontent
description: The settlement loses 25 loyalty (when loyalty is on). Not in capitals or city-states.

name: Lift a Masterpiece
description: Steal one of the settlement's great works into an empty slot of yours.
